name: Davenport Summit
title: Davenport Summit Window Cleaning | Sweetwater | CleanzATX
description: Window cleaning in gated Davenport Summit, Sweetwater. Pure water glass for $900K to $1.5M homes, from $10 a window, stone and stucco soft washed.
intro: Davenport Summit is a gated estate section of Sweetwater on Davenport Divide, with homes from $900K to $1.5M. CleanzATX cleans glass here with your gate code on file and no ladders against the stone.

sections.h2: What Davenport Summit homes are like
paragraphs: Davenport Summit sits on Davenport Divide inside Sweetwater, and it is one of the two gated sections of the community. Homes are priced from about $900,000 to $1.5 million, a clear step up from the median across Sweetwater. The Sweetwater HOA governs it, with higher dues for the gated sections. Fewer homes and a gate mean a quiet feel, and owners often like to know exactly who comes through.
Estate style means big stone and stucco elevations, tall entries, and a lot of glass on the back side where covered patios look out over the Hill Country.

sections.h2: What Davenport Summit windows deal with
paragraphs: Height on the divide draws wind, and wind draws dust. Even with a gate, windows here collect dust blown off nearby grading, because Sweetwater is still building out. The dust settles on tall panes and transoms, and dew bonds it to the glass. Sprinklers from large lots hit the lower sections of the wall, leaving hard water spots that can etch with time.

Pollen follows the seasons, cedar from December to February and oak in March and April. West facing back windows in afternoon sun reveal any residue, so pure water matters. The stone is soft washed, never pressure washed.

Gate details are part of the quote, and we confirm the day before so no one waits at the entrance. We park on the driveway if you prefer, and we do not need your hose, as 200 gallons ride on the skid. Water fed poles reach up to three stories, which fits the tall front entries here. Owners in this section often add a roof soft wash, from $0.25 per square foot with a $400 minimum, on the same trip.
For a 4,500 square foot home, exterior windows run about $450, taking roughly three and a half to four and a half hours. The inside adds about two and a quarter hours and brings the total near $675.

why: Gated section handled with a code in the quote and a confirmation the day before.
Tall entries and transoms are reached with poles from the ground.
We bring our own 200 gallons, so your hose stays untouched.
Roof and stone soft washing can be done on the same trip.

faq.q: How do you handle the gate?
faq.a: Text us the code or the gate contact with your address. We keep it on the job sheet and confirm the day before.

faq.q: Why do my tall windows get so dusty?
faq.a: Lots up on the divide catch wind, and nearby building adds dust. Pure water cleaning rinses it off and leaves no film for new dust to cling to.

faq.q: Can you reach the top windows safely?
faq.a: Yes. Our poles reach three stories from the ground, and interior two story windows are done with cotton covered ladders and drop cloths.

faq.q: Do you hook up to my hose bib?
faq.a: No. We bring 200 gallons and a pure water system on the skid, so there is no need to hook up to your spigot.

faq.q: Will you soft wash my stone?
faq.a: Yes, and stone is only ever soft washed. House soft wash begins at $0.20 per square foot, $400 minimum.
